status: Authored and internally reviewed; content, audio, focused browser and offline gates passed. Native review pending.
method: Independent publisher-authored rules; original examples. Editorial levels and simplified usage explanations are not an official syllabus.

points.formation: Dictionary verb + たびに; event noun のたびに.
points.teachingChoice: Recurring event/response, not arbitrary clock intervals. Emotion is possible, not obligatory. Actual event repetition must be stated, not inferred from one example.

points.form: 間/間に and 最中に
sources: https://jlptsensei.com/learn-japanese-grammar/真っ最中に-まっさいちゅうに-saichuu-ni-meaning/
levels: N4 bridge; generalized の間に N3 at Bunpro
N4 間/間に, N3 最中に at Sensei
points.formation: Interval: attributive clause, noun の, na-adjective な. 最中: ている or noun の; predicate 最中だ.
points.teachingChoice: Continuing through a span versus event/completion within it; 最中 stresses full progress. Interruption frequent, not compulsory. No blanket ban on an action taking time inside an interval. Named constructions for attachment tests; temporal tasks need explicit span clues.

points.formation: Verb dictionary/progressive/negative, i-adjective, na-adjective な, noun の.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve unit 2 opportunity before state changes. Also recognise gradual change while an activity continues, not exclusively deliberate opportunity. Negative 忘れないうちに is before forgetting, not after.

points.formation: Verb stem/noun + がち; predicate がちだ, modifier がちな/がちの, adverb がちに where idiomatic.
points.teachingChoice: Recurring propensity, usually unwanted but not always negative. No identity stereotypes or diagnosis. A recurrence claim requires repeated observations, not merely one tired day.

points.formation: Verb stem/noun + 気味 (suffix read ぎみ); predicate 気味だ, adverb 気味に, common nominal modifier 気味の.
points.teachingChoice: Slight signs/state or inclination, often undesired. Contrast relative focus with がち without pretending all uses are mutually exclusive or exclusively permanent/temporary. Use self-reported 疲れ気味 and schedule 遅れ気味; language evidence is not health diagnosis.

remaining: Native review of sentences and listening. Two lessons, 32 new pairs, five notes, two ten-line scenes, 218-character diary, 18 tasks.
